title: Karnataka BJP stages protest against Congress Govt over price hikes; Former CM Bommai calls it "anti-people"

ai.summary: Karnataka sugarcane farmers protested over lower state offers for their crop after the government reduced prices from Rs 3,500 to Rs 3,300 per tonne.

facts.claim: Karnataka sugarcane farmers protested over lower state offers for their crop after the government reduced prices from Rs 3,500 to Rs 3,300 per tonne.
facts.quote: Karnataka sugarcane farmers (Gurlapur Cross (Belagavi), Mudhol (Bagalkot), Haveri). Farmers in north Karnataka wanted Rs 3,500 a tonne for their cane after harvesting and transport costs. The state offered Rs 3,300; some called off their protest and others held out.

ai.background_note: Karnataka sugarcane farmers in north Karnataka demanded Rs 3,500 per tonne for their cane after harvesting and transport costs, but the state offered Rs 3,300, leading to protests.
